description: An op authored under schemaless epoch 0 (SCHEMA.md §2/§3: implicit lww/any-scalar default) pools with an epoch-1 op of the same type. a1 (ep=0) and a2 (ep=1) are both lww with no change_crdt, so they share one total order; a2 (@40) outranks a1 (@30). Exercises the schemaless start-level path.
